recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four men seated around a weathered wooden table in a dimly lit, rustic bar setting. The composition is framed by a geometric Art Deco-inspired border and topped with stylized, layered typography featuring a mix of blocky sans-serif and expressive script.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm interior lighting contrasting with deep shadows in the background
Rough, tactile wood grain of the table leading the eye toward the subjects
Geometric frame containing the organic, candid poses of the band members
Layered typography integrated with decorative line-work at the top center
coreInvariants: A double-line geometric border with square corner accents
A weathered, reclaimed wood table surface in the foreground
A candid, conversational atmosphere among the subjects
Muted, earthy color palette dominated by browns, tans, and deep greens

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally across the middle ground, seated behind a large wooden table that occupies the lower third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central group of men, specifically their faces and hands resting on the table.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large typography at the top, moves down the decorative lines to the subjects' faces, and follows the perspective of the table toward the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas in the upper corners and background bar interior provide contrast for the subjects and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the background and table shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and beige for the typography and border lines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blues and greens in the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the bright faces/text and the dark environment.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and expressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses tall, condensed, blocky capitals with slight irregularities to mimic wood-cut or stamped effects
Secondary text uses a fluid, slanted brush script with variable line weight
Text is arched or follows a subtle curve to fit within decorative line-work
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the primary title have distressed edges and internal texture
The script text includes long, sweeping descenders and underlines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, industrial block letters and organic, personal handwriting.
graphicDevices: Double-line geometric border with square corner knots
Curved horizontal lines framing the main title
Tally-mark icons used as a decorative divider

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rustic, tactile theme of the table and bar.
Provides the necessary organic contrast to the block text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A photograph of four men in casual jackets and shirts sitting at a very old, textured wooden table in a dark bar. The lighting should be warm and focused on their faces. Include a taxidermy deer head on the wall in the background. The overall mood is friendly and candid.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a double-lined tan border with square corner details. At the top center, place the primary title in a condensed, distressed block font following a slight arch. Below it, add the secondary title in a gold-toned brush script. Include thin decorative lines and tally marks between the text and the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the wood grain on the table prominent and textured?
Does the border have the specific double-line geometric corners?
Is the typography a mix of blocky and script styles?
Is the lighting warm and moody rather than bright and flat?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects at the table
Degree of distressing on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific tally mark count if it refers to a trademarked count
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the border lines are perfectly straight and corners are symmetrical.
Check that the script text looks hand-drawn, not like a standard font.
Verify the lighting on the subjects matches the environment.
Confirm the texture on the block letters is visible but doesn't hinder legibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a candid group portrait in a rustic interior with a geometric Art Deco frame and a mix of distressed block and script typography for a modern-western aesthetic.
